articles.title: Kothari Industrial gets DGCA certification for KOAIR-10L agricultural spraying drone
articles.summary: Kothari Industrial Corporation Ltd (KICL) has secured Type certification from India's Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) for its KOAIR-10L agricultural drone. This crucial approval allows KICL to commercially operate and deploy the indigenous drone for various farming applications, boosting precision agriculture and furthering drone technology adoption within the country.
